correctness.rationale: For each translation a, the cubic derivative has the explicitly displayed alternating matrix; the four-group kernel formula is proved by block-constant row equations, reducing the rank calculation to <=4 group sums and accounting for within-group fluctuations. Substituting group sizes and binomial multiplicities yields the exhaustive rank histogram, with coincident ranks added. Quadratic Walsh orthogonality gives exactly 2^r nonzero Pauli amplitudes of size 2^{-r/2}; hence all-alpha moments and limits. A separate standard-library verifier checked 1620 h,w size cases through n=30, every binary shift for n=4..11, and direct Walsh transforms for n=4..8. Finite evidence is corroborative, not a universal certificate.

originality.rationale: The claim is the full exact translation-rank and Pauli-magnitude distribution of the one-CCZ-deleted complete 3-uniform state, not merely the scalar m2. Kagamihara--Tsuchiya supply the general rank-to-moment formula but no rank distribution for this dense defective graph. Chen--Yan--Zhou supply full-state moments and the p-random three-edge retention average for alpha=2. Differentiation at p=1 implies the scalar single-deletion alpha=2 moment, which is acknowledged as covered. It does not determine the defective-state distribution of ranks or all alpha moments. Searches of all available current and prior own ledgers, published-finding corpus semantic records, and primary full texts did not uncover the rank-spectrum classification. An independently indexed special case remains possible; search absence does not prove priority.

value.rationale: Omitting precisely one CCZ from a fully symmetric dense hypergraph is a natural single-gate preparation fault. The exact all-n distribution of Pauli expectation magnitudes is a complete natural invariant rather than an arbitrary small numerical slice: it gives all stabilizer Renyi moments, permits exact resource comparisons across orders, and shows removal of a non-Clifford gate can increase second-order magic by a nonzero asymptotic amount. Published m2 alone does not provide these higher moments or the expectation histogram. The model is intentionally ideal and does not imply practical noise robustness.
